heading: Your AI helpers and Ask about Meldmind
body: Your AI helpers: Meldmind lists the AI apps on this PC, shows which are ready or resting until a set time, and gives each step to one that is free. Find it in Expert Settings under My AIs. When a step moves to another helper, the first try stays visible, for example Try 1 (Claude Code: out of usage). Ask about Meldmind: ask why a job cost what it did, which AI planned it, or why a helper is resting, and get an answer from Meldmind's own records. It is in Help, and in Expert it opens from the Live feed. It only reads; it never changes a setting, and it never shows your keys or private chats. Expert Settings fits beside the Live feed on a laptop screen. If something on the screen fails, Meldmind says so in plain words instead of showing a program error, and keeps the details in its log for support. If your antivirus stops an update from starting, Meldmind stays open and offers the installer to download, instead of closing.
